title: Research: exclude arbitrary terminal R439 star compensation under fixed frames
body:
Omitting a helper-star restoration leaks arbitrary leaf dirt into later targets. PR1580 rules out merely moving unchanged restorations to the end of C. This contribution answers its explicit follow-up: **no arbitrary appended elementary-XOR compensation can repair any nonempty omitted-restoration subset** on the three fixed PR967/PR1062 words while preserving the existing monotone common frames and final targets, even with arbitrary restored dirty extra wires.

The exact post-C dependency cone contains only each target itself: all 439 helpers and 111 sources are at rank eight; the 111 targets occupy distinct rank-seven final hyperplanes. A short monotone-frame dependency proof excludes relaying a required leaf coordinate through extra wires. Distinct leaf columns extend the defect to every nonempty subset without an exponential search. The general boundary reasoning is credited to Ali Romman/PR1128 and Cinna Davis/PR1393; PR1580 owns the fixed-word defect. The new result is this source-bound terminal-target application, plus sharp frame-free repair bills.

For a one-star correction affecting w targets and its center, the sharp scalar cost is w+1 XORs for one leaf or w+3 for two leaves (arbitrary restored dirty extras allowed). Both exceed keeping the early restoration, by w or w+1. These scalar witnesses deliberately fail the real frame contract; no legal repaired supplier or new kappa is claimed.

Validation on macOS arm64, standard-library CPython 3.12.14/3.14.7:

- Registered Python 3.12 replay and all five package test groups pass, including optimized read-only minimal export and actual input/receipt corruptions.
- Exact rational cones for all 333 target occurrences; all 880 within-star repair cases on 661 dirty columns forward/reverse; separate direct Boolean witnesses and dot-product cone oracle.
- Exhaustive finite legal-suffix fixture with a dirty extra, scalar dense-input fixtures, and a small shorter-word exclusion support the written proof.
- All 20 repository research-workflow tests pass (one skipped); selected-source arithmetic/bindings, source metadata/pins and staged whitespace checks pass. Separate Python 3.14 optimized replay passes.

One seven-file package is added under `research/r439-terminal-repair-barrier/`; CERTIFICATE.json is generated evidence. Source base is current main `1f327c6f3e3a35271c5c141d381b540bab8ad005`. One OS draw selected bit-helper-contract; TASK explicitly records the scope change because PR1194/1311 already address restored semantic-D substitution. Final overlap at 03:36 UTC covered 727 open PRs and 233 Discussion records with complete pagination; search limitations and exact heads are retained.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-terminal-repair-barrier
```

Native multistage/whole-hosted emission, physical adoption, changed precision/tape, all-size realization, analytic transfer and Lean verification are unrun. No selected frontier change. The concrete next question moves the cut before an affected target reaches its hyperplane and changes the continuation, with every carrier/frame charge priced. Hosted CI and maintainer acceptance remain separate from local checks.

Credit PR1580/1017, PR1128/1393 and related complex PR1517; PR1194/1311; PR967/1062/915/926/1015/923; DreamingOfClouds/eumemic PR589/555/543 and PR425 scalar/checker lineage.
